CITY ADMIN 12 Oct 2026

New one-stop service counter opens at Tha Phae Gate district office

Residents in the old-town zone can now submit 37 types of requests at a single counter, cutting average wait time from 90 to 25 minutes.

EVENT 05 Oct 2026

49th Chiang Mai Flower Festival 2027 — vendor registration now open

Food and craft vendors along the parade route can reserve stalls online. Early-bird fee ฿1,500 until 30 Nov 2026.

INFRASTRUCTURE 28 Sep 2026

Ping River waterfront phase 2 begins — Nawarat Bridge to Iron Bridge

A 1.8 km public walkway and flood-wall improvement project, budget ฿42 million, expected completion Q2 2027.
